{{Quote|Have you been to the Rau? Some of these farmers live their whole lives and never go. It's not much of a city, but you'd think over time, they'd get curious.|Krole to Bix Caleen|<ref name="Sagrona Teema" />}}
'''Rau''' was a [[city]] that was located on the [[planet]] [[Mina-Rau]] that was not far from [[Council 436]].<ref name="Sagrona Teema" /> When returning to the planet in [[4 BBY]]<ref name="Sagrona Teema Date">{{AndorDate|202}}</ref> to perform an [[Imperial Supply Census]], [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant]] [[Krole]] and other Imperial personnel ate a meal Krole considered "decent" in Rau. The following [[Standard day|day]], he made conversation with the [[Technician|mechanic]] [[Bix Caleen]] about Rau, commenting that it had changed in the [[Standard year|years]] since he had last seen it.<ref name="Sagrona Teema" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rau was mentioned in the [[Sagrona Teema|second episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' which was released<ref name="Sagrona Teema" /> on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
